subject: Remove duplicate c->flag.blocked check (#4617)
reason: The change removes a redundant `!c->flag.blocked` check inside a block that is only entered when `!c->flag.blocked` already holds (the enclosing `if (update_command_stats && !c->flag.blocked)` in call() in src/server.c). The inner condition's truth value is unchanged in every reachable state, so command latency histogram updates occur in exactly the same cases on both builds. This is a no-op refactor with no observable behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
